finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts::block-style serializer is duplicated backend/frontend; only the backend copy was hardened, so the two crdt encoders now diverge
evidence: The diff hardens only packages/backend/src/yorkie/docs-tree.ts (serializeBlockStyle/parseBlockStyle now emit/accept only finite values) and touches nothing block-style-related in packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts. The backend file's header explicitly says it is a "deliberate, narrowly-scoped mirror" of the frontend store and suggests extracting a shared helper, so the frontend copy retaining the old unconditional String()/Number() pattern is almost certain — though the excerpt omits lines 161-2918, so I could not read the frontend serializeBlockStyle directly (hence medium confidence). The divergence is real; impact is modest since the frontend editor always supplies fully-populated BlockStyle, leaving mainly the frontend reader's residual NaN vulnerability to legacy "undefined" attributes.
